summary: FibroBiologics, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 1, 2026, announcing entry into an At-The-Market (ATM) Offering Agreement with H.C. Wainwright Co., LLC to sell up to $6.15M of common stock. The shares are sold via Rule 415 at prevailing market prices; the agent receives 3.0% gross commission plus expense reimbursement. This is a routine capital-raising facility, not a transformative special situation event. Proceeds fund working capital. No definitive shares are committed. The filing is a standard shelf takedown mechanism with no premium, target, or activist involvement, thus not a special situation.
